variants.headline: {{city}} rebounds as settlement fortunes diverge
body: After an earlier population decline, {{cityLink}} gained {{recoveryGrowth}} population between turns {{recoveryFromTurn}} and {{recoveryToTurn}}, reaching {{population}}. Across the comparison at turns {{contrastFromTurn}} and {{contrastToTurn}}, {{otherCity}} changed by {{otherGrowth}}.
The rebound gives this settlement a fresh place in the provincial account. Compare food and current production in both cities when reviewing their next priorities.
